pool_offset_term_generalized_2026_change.description: Frozen 2020-25 offset coefficient applied to 2026 weeks 3-8 real pool lines vs Tuesday-noon market lines
pool_offset_term_generalized_2026_change.plain_summary: Applying the fitted offset term to 2026 weeks 3-8 with the real pool and Tuesday market numbers (103 games, 51 with a gap of half a point or more) changes no pick: the average probability move is under one point and the card already sits within a point of even in the games it would touch. The offset side still went 36-22 live.

pool_offset_term_generalized_logloss.description: Offset term (logit cover at pool line minus at market line) added to four-term fit, LOSO 2020-25, stacked offsets +-0.5 and +-1.0
pool_offset_term_generalized_logloss.notes: accuracy +0.92 pts ci -0.64..2.38 P+ 0.869; 0.5 offsets only: logloss +0.00086 P+ 0.968, coef 0.69-0.87; 1.0 offsets only: logloss +0.00384 P+ 1.0, accuracy +2.09 P+ 0.991, coef 0.87-0.99; whole-number market lines only coef 0.18-0.38 logloss +0.00016 P+ 0.818. 12 metric looks across 4 populations. Scratch p1.py/p2.py agentPO.
pool_offset_term_generalized_logloss.plain_summary: When the pool posts a number a half point or a full point off the market, adding a term for that gap improved the out-of-season probability fit on simulated 2020-25 offsets (log loss 0.68767 to 0.68529). The term's weight was steady at 0.85 to 0.96 per season, near the hook's 0.77-0.88. This is largely mechanical, since the target is graded at the pool line. Applied to 2026 weeks 3-8 it changes no pick.
